review_notes: I read the whole file. I checked its main definitions against the library and Mathlib. `IsStrictlyLeviPseudoconvexAt` is a new strict variant of `IsLeviPseudoconvexAt` and reuses `IsComplexTangent` and `leviForm`. `complexPart` is an abbreviation for Mathlib's `StrongDual.extendRCLike`, so the library already integrates with Mathlib there. `leviBilinear` is the polarized complex-bilinear part of a real bilinear form. `leviQuadratic` in Necessity.lean is its diagonal, and `leviBilinear_self` links the two, so they are not independent competing concepts. I did not find a Mathlib definition of the complexification or complex-bilinear part of a real bilinear form on a complex space that `leviBilinear` would duplicate. The only remaining uncertainty is that I did not search all of Mathlib exhaustively for such a construction.
